versions.changelog:
Initial release of passive-income-generator.

- Automates creation and management of digital products, affiliate campaigns, subscription services, and AI agent skills.
- Supports automatic posting to multiple marketplaces: Gumroad, SellApp, Whop, Lemon Squeezy, Etsy, and ClawHub.
- Tracks earnings, conversion rates, and optimizes pricing based on demand.
- Integrates email marketing funnels, Stripe payment links, and recurring billing for automated sales.
- Includes an income dashboard, analytics, and automated reporting features.
